name: Valacyclovir
description: The L-valyl ester prodrug of aciclovir, approved for herpes zoster, genital herpes and cold sores, with far better oral bioavailability than the parent.

systems.note: Viral DNA polymerase inhibition; the labelled antiviral indication.
Crystalline nephropathy with inadequate hydration; renal dose adjustment is labelled.
Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura is labelled in severely immunocompromised patients.

monitors.why: Crystalline nephropathy is the characteristic renal risk.
